label: Capt. Eric D. Carlson
narrative: Eric Carlson commanded the Echo Flight capsule on the morning its ten missiles dropped off alert, and he is a witness for the negative. He states he received no report of a UFO, that he was sitting about two feet from Walter Figel when the radio call the UFO account depends on is said to have come in, and that he does not recall any subsequent debriefing. He belongs on this board for exactly the same reason the affirming witnesses do, and the board should be as careful with his account as with theirs: like theirs, it reaches the public through an interested party, in his case his own son, whose published work argues the Malmstrom UFO story is a hoax. That does not make him wrong. It makes his account structurally the same kind of evidence as the accounts it contradicts, which is the point CLAUDE.md section 2a exists to record.
